claim.claim-text: a first winding comprising a first wire section and a second wire section, the first wire section and the second wire section are disposed parallel to each other in a first horizontal plane associated with a center axis, and the first winding associated with an equivalent current flow path within the first horizontal plane; a second winding to extend around the center axis in the first horizontal plane between the first wire section and the second wire section, wherein the equivalent current flow path of the first winding is aligned with a current flow path associated with the second winding.

2. The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising at least one wire section extending from the second winding and disposed on a second horizontal plane, the second horizontal plane being parallel to the first horizontal plane.
3. The apparatus of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the first winding is provided on a first layer and the first winding is coupled to a second layer.
4. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 3, further comprising a plus node and a minus node interconnected to the first winding by a via.
5. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the first and second wire sections are metal traces.
6. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the second winding is a metal trace.
7. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the first winding has at least two turns.
8. The apparatus of claim 7, wherein the second winding has at least two turns.
9. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the equivalent current path is disposed between the first wire section and the second wire section.
10. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the second winding is interconnected to a center tap by at least one interconnection element.
11. The apparatus of claim 10, wherein the at least one interconnection element comprises a via.
12. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the secondary winding is equidistant from the first wire section and the second wire section.
13. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the primary winding and the secondary winding in the first horizontal plane are the same metallic material.
14. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 13, further comprising a connection element connecting the first winding with the second winding with interconnection elements.
15. A method of manufacturing an inductance apparatus, the method comprising:

placing a first winding comprising a first wire section and a second wire section, the first wire section and the second wire section are disposed parallel to each other in a first horizontal plane associated with a center axis, and the first winding associated with an equivalent current flow path within the first horizontal plane; placing a second winding to extend via the center axis in the first horizontal plane to the first wire section and the second wire section, wherein the equivalent current flow path of the first winding is aligned with a current flow path associated with the second winding.
